answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow charges each identity to look distinct. Each agent locks a 50-credit bond; each epoch the network samples the pulse of its work, its timing gaps, against its 10-epoch horizon. A match releases earnings; a mismatch freezes escrow and a proven clone forfeits the bond. A zephyr of jitter is natural, but faking 1,000 fingerprints costs 20 credits each, 20,000 for the farm, while an honest pulse matches free.
